about.title: Confidence you can wear
about.story: Born from a love for clothing — we created Caraíba because we wanted a brand that speaks to women, not just trends. Too much fashion forgets the power of wearing something that fits well, feels natural, and reflects personality. We built a brand designed around women. Today, we are a growing community of women who love color, sunlight, comfort, elegance, and presence. Every collection is created with the same promise: to help her feel confident and beautiful in every look.
about.value1Desc: Thoughtful fits and finishes that celebrate real bodies and real life.
about.value2Desc: Fabrics and layers chosen for real weather — from crisp mornings to warm nights.
about.value3Desc: Pieces you can mix, match, and make your own — never generic.
about.heroTitle: Fashion that makes you feel seen
about.heroSubtitle: Our mission is simple: give every woman the confidence that comes from style that truly fits who she is.
about.mission: To sell women’s fashion that inspires confidence, enhances beauty, and makes every customer feel unique.
about.storyTitle: Born from a love of style
about.storyParagraph1: We started Caraíba because we wanted a brand that spoke to women, not trends alone. Too much fashion forgets how powerful it feels to put on something that fits right, looks effortless, and reflects your personality. We set out to build a lineup of clothing, swimwear, bags, and jewelry that does exactly that.
about.storyParagraph2: Today we’re a growing community of women who love colour, versatility, and pieces that travel with them — from the beach to the city, and through every season. Every drop is curated with the same promise: help you feel confident, beautiful, and undeniably yourself.
about.value1DescFull: We focus on quality construction, flattering cuts, and details that last beyond a single season — without compromising on the joy of getting dressed.
about.value2DescFull: We strive to make more sustainable choices whenever possible — better materials, responsible production partners, and packaging that respects the planet.
about.value3DescFull: Our range is for women who want fashion that respects individuality — different moods, different bodies, one shared love of feeling good in what you wear.
about.ctaSubtitle: Explore bikinis, handbags, purses, jewelry, accessories, and much more, designed to celebrate your confidence and individuality.

testimonials.title: What our customers say
testimonials.subtitle: Real women, real Caraíba moments
testimonials.description: We’re grateful to everyone who shops with us and shares the love.
testimonials.r1text: My Caraíba bikini fits like a dream — I felt confident at the beach for the first time in years. The quality is gorgeous.
testimonials.r2text: Ordered a bag and earrings for a trip — so many compliments. The whole vibe is effortless and polished.
testimonials.r3text: Finally a brand that feels grown-up and fun at the same time. Fast shipping and beautiful packaging.
testimonials.r4text: The jewelry is delicate but stands out. I wear my Caraíba pieces almost every day.
testimonials.r5text: Love the edits — everything mixes and matches. My holiday suitcase is basically all Caraíba now.
testimonials.r6text: Customer service helped me pick a size — the swimsuit is flattering and true to the photos. Will shop again.
